from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,sys,re
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True;sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
from example_proof_gate import validate_current
from cost_audit import audit_run
root=Path.cwd();parent=root/'_build/pid-ground-integral-parent/20261110T060707-ad09b17141/five-verify'
commands=json.loads((parent/'commands.json').read_text());f=next(c for c in commands if 'freeze-existing-model-and-position-translation-evidence' in c['id'])
old=json.loads((parent/f['stdout']).read_text())['protected_sha256']
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
changed=[n for n,h in old.items() if not(root/n).is_file() or sha(root/n)!=h];assert not changed,changed
print('UNCHANGED_FROZEN_ORIGINAL_FILES',len(old))
base=root/'paparazzi/relations/pid_ground_integral_independence';attempt=base/'attempts/001'
status=json.loads((base/'problem/status.json').read_text())
assert status['status']=='proved' and status['active_attempt']=='../attempts/001'
assert len(status['requested_goals'])==5
validate_current(root,base/'problem',attempt,status)
print('NEW_EXACT_FIVE_GOAL_VALIDATION_PASS',status['requested_goals'])
case=root/'paparazzi/models/guidance_pid_h_run_pos';previous=root/'paparazzi/relations/pid_position_translation'
for oldbase,num in [(previous,'002'),(case/'rocq/no_error','002'),(case/'rocq/termination','002'),(case/'rocq/cbmc_recheck','003')]:
 st=json.loads((oldbase/'problem/status.json').read_text());validate_current(root,oldbase/'problem',oldbase/'attempts'/num,st)
print('EXISTING_RELATION_AND_MODEL_GOAL_RECEIPTS_STILL_PASS')
for stage in ['prepare','cbmc','align','rocq']:
 for row in json.loads((case/stage/'handoff.json').read_text())['outputs']:
  p=(case/row['path']).resolve();assert p.is_file() and sha(p)==row['sha256'],p
print('ALL_ORIGINAL_STAGE_HANDOFF_HASHES_PASS')
proof=(attempt/'Proof.v').read_text();assert not re.search(r'^\s*(Admitted\.|Axiom\s|Parameter\s)',proof,re.M)
v=json.loads((attempt/'evidence/goal-validation.json').read_text());worker=root/v['certificate']['run']
meta=json.loads((worker/'run.json').read_text());assert meta['status']=='passed'
cs=json.loads((worker/'commands.json').read_text());assert all(c.get('gnu_time') is not None for c in cs)
max_rss=max(c['gnu_time']['max_process_rss_kib']*1024 for c in cs)
metrics=json.loads((worker/'metrics.json').read_text());assert max_rss==metrics['memory']['max_individual_process_rss_bytes']
zero=[{'id':c['id'],'samples':c.get('rss_sample_count'),'peak':c.get('peak_process_tree_rss_sampled_bytes'),'gnu_rss_bytes':c['gnu_time']['max_process_rss_kib']*1024} for c in cs if not c.get('peak_process_tree_rss_sampled_bytes')]
assert len(zero)==1 and zero[0]['id'].startswith('010-') and zero[0]['peak']==0 and zero[0]['samples']>0,zero
audit=audit_run(worker);assert audit['status']!='complete'
print('DEFAULT_COST_AUDIT_RETAINED',json.dumps(audit,ensure_ascii=False))
print('COMPLETE_GNU_TIME_MEMORY_COVERAGE',json.dumps({'commands':len(cs),'max_individual_process_rss_bytes':max_rss,'sampled_zero_command':zero},ensure_ascii=False))
print('ARTIFACT_FILES',[str(p.relative_to(base)) for p in sorted(base.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()])
print('WORKER_METRICS',json.dumps({'time':metrics['time'],'token_total_own':metrics['tokens']['total_tokens'],'memory':metrics['memory']},ensure_ascii=False))
print('All requested mathematical/source/type/hash checks passed; primary GNUtime memory measured for every command; default sampling edge retained.')
